query: WITH matched_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT workspace_user.user_id FROM workspace_user INNER JOIN "user" ON workspace_user.user_id = "user".id WHERE workspace_user.workspace_id = $1 AND ($2::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".first_name ILIKE '%' || $2::TEXT || '%') AND ($3::TEXT IS NULL OR "user".last_name ILIKE '%' || $3::TEXT || '%')), users_page AS (SELECT user_id FROM matched_users ORDER BY user_id LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5) SELECT workspace_user.user_id AS "user_id!", workspace_user.role_id AS "role_id!", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched_users) AS "total_count!" FROM workspace_user INNER JOIN users_page ON users_page.user_id = workspace_user.user_id WHERE workspace_user.workspace_id = $1 ORDER BY workspace_user.user_id, workspace_user.role_id;
